panels.description: ANN recall: the same saved question vector goes to the engine, and its top 10 is compared with an exact search of the live documents. It does not call the model. 1.00 means the engine returns what an exact search would. If it drops, look at the engine or the index.

panels.description: Embedding check. The probe embeds the text of 5 saved games again with the live model and compares each new vector with the vector stored for that game. 1.00 means the same vector. A different model gives a much lower value. It does not call the engine.
panels.title: Embedding check: vector similarity

panels.description: Query check. Saved test questions are embedded now with the live model and searched in the engine. Their top 10 is compared with the top 10 for the vector the question had when the catalog was built. 1.00 means the same results. A different model drops it on both engines. If only one engine drops, that engine has a problem, for example deleted documents in OpenSearch.
panels.title: Query check: result overlap
